headline: Morocco: net assets of UCITS fall 0.28% at end of October 2026
summary: Net assets under management of Moroccan collective investment schemes (OPCVM) stood at 817.90 billion dirhams at end-October 2026. That is down from 820.19 billion a month earlier, a decline of 0.28%.
why: Collective investment schemes pool savings from households and institutions and are a gauge of asset flows in Morocco's financial sector. Changes in assets reflect both market performance and investor flows.
original_headline: Maroc : l’actif net des OPCVM recule de 0,28 % à fin octobre 2026
